plugins.name: doom-pane
plugins.description: The original DOOM in a pane with nothing to install: id's engine (doomgeneric, GPL-2) compiled to JavaScript runs inside the mod, the shareware episode and Freedoom Phase 1 ship with the plugin, the picture is half-block pixels on a Raster. /doom opens it; w a s d move, q e strafe, f fires, u uses, m opens the menu. Your own IWAD plays too, split into 2 MiB parts. Saves live in the plugin store.
